title: Review applications and enrol accepted applicants
text: Open Applications to review a coach or trainer application. Record an acceptance or rejection and a reason. Acceptance does not create login credentials. Create a suitable future batch in Training & configuration, then enrol the accepted applicant with the correct seat type. A full batch creates a waitlist entry. Enrolment creates an invited account and queues an email invitation. The applicant sets their own password from the invitation. Check Service status for blocked email deliveries. Never give an applicant an administrator password.

title: Account access and password help
text: Sign in with your invited account email or phone and your own password. Selecting a different Login as role does not grant that role. Forgot your password creates a single-use reset email request if the account is eligible. Email delivery requires the configured email provider. Ask administration if your invitation has expired or your assigned work is missing. The assistant cannot change passwords, grant access or perform administrative actions.

title: Invite staff and manage access
text: Open People & access to invite an administrator, finance lead, trainer or mentor. Record a reason for the invitation or any suspension or deactivation. Coach accounts are created through application enrolment. Owners choose their passwords from invitations. Use Manage to resend an invitation, suspend or restore an eligible account. Staff assignments and coach ownership are enforced on the server. Do not send passwords through contact forms or the assistant.

title: Faculty training and examination workflow
text: Faculty and mentors see trainees assigned to their batch or mentoring relationship in My trainees. An active faculty member records module completion after checking the learning evidence. All required modules must be complete before an administrator schedules an exam. Examiners must be active, cleared for that part and within their calibration period. A trainee's own mentor cannot mark that trainee. An observed debrief requires two independent markers; other parts require one. Examinations shows a faculty member only the exams assigned to them.

title: First login, undertaking and learning
text: After accepting your invitation and setting your password, sign in as your assigned coach role. Read and sign the current Data undertaking, confirm the confidentiality promise, then confirm first login. My learning shows your assigned batch, sessions, modules and progress. The Learning library requires a signed current undertaking. If a new undertaking is published, read and sign it again. Contact administration if no batch is linked to your account.

title: Offer coaching availability
text: Availability is available to provisional and active coaches after signing the current undertaking. Choose a date, start and end time and up to 12 weekly repeats. Sessions are 45 minutes with a 15-minute gap. Overlapping slots are rejected. Slots inside the configured lock window require an admin request; the default is 72 hours and the current policy may differ. Only open slots may be closed by the coach. Booked sessions need an administrative change. Aarambh slot delivery remains pending while the integration is disconnected.

title: Prepare, run and finish a debrief
text: Open My debriefs and choose a session assigned to you. An active Aarambh reading and a signed undertaking are required for reading access and session start. Save your preparation and questions before starting Live mode; questions lock after the run starts. Confirm session consent, coverage and confidentiality before progressing. Finish the session, then write and review the feedback letter and complete all four conversation ratings. Supply a recommendation or a reason for none. Submit follow-up only after reviewing it. Submission does not mean Aarambh validation; it remains pending until the integration delivers and validates it.

title: Calculate and review session pay
text: Enter actual coach pay agreements or pay slab rates in Training & configuration before creating a pay run. Finance calculates session fees from submitted follow-ups and applicable rates. Missing rates reject the calculation without creating a partial pay run. Review the lines, verify payout details externally and record a reason before approving. After an actual bank payment, record its external reference. This website does not transfer money. Monthly commitments, cancellation pay and fee-sharing calculations are not implemented in the current pay run.

title: Raise a correction or scheduling request
text: Use My requests to describe a detail correction, time-commitment change, session move or locked-slot change. Provide a clear summary and reason, including the relevant session or slot identifier if known. Administration reviews the request. A request is not automatically approved. You can see its state and decision reason in My requests. For privacy enquiries use the public Contact page and choose Privacy and data.

title: Review requests and contact enquiries
text: Requests shows pending operational change requests. Review the requested change, select approved or declined, and record a reason. On approval the supported operational change is applied in the same database transaction as the decision. Contact inbox is separate: it stores enquiries submitted through the public Contact form. Mark an enquiry reviewed or closed after handling it. Inbox receipt does not mean an email reply was sent.

title: Understand disconnected external services
text: Service status shows local SQLite connectivity and queued email or Aarambh delivery. Email is only sent after the configured provider accepts the request. Aarambh is deferred and must not be treated as connected. Google Analytics and Search Console configuration are deferred by the owner. No production domain verification or hosted deployment has been established. Database records shows saved operational records; it does not contain fake demo business data.

title: Code of Ethics and coach credential
text: After all four exam parts have passed, read and sign the current Code of Ethics and the current undertaking. In My profile & credential choose the initial time commitment, then request your credential. The backend checks these prerequisites. A newly issued credential enters the provisional stage. Your assigned mentor records mentoring hours and supervised sessions before signing off progression to active status. The assistant cannot issue a credential or approve progression for you.
